metrics.profile_summary: Social media and brand marketing specialist with a finance-trained analytical background. Expert in AI-driven content operations, brand positioning, and multi-platform campaign management.

experience.description: Supports Shopify analytics, website performance tracking, and social media metrics for client brands.
Led a 7-person team to build an AI marketing stack and launched multi-channel campaigns on Instagram and TikTok.
Developed Gen Z rebranding strategy and competitive analysis, winning the client brief.
Grew personal lifestyle/beauty accounts using algorithm-driven strategies and CapCut editing.
Directed visual branding and social campaigns for six large-scale student productions.

strengths: Advanced AI tool proficiency for content and research
Strong analytical skills from finance background
Direct experience with Instagram, TikTok, and Meta Business Suite
Proven ability to conduct competitor and market research
weaknesses: Degree is in Finance rather than Marketing/Communications
evaluation.summary: Highly capable candidate who exceeds technical requirements. While experience is primarily internship and project-based, the candidate demonstrates professional-level execution in social media management, AI integration, and data-driven reporting.
